title: Optional map vs flatMap
hints: Use `flatMap` for steps that can fail (first field, `Int(...)`) and `map` for the final squaring.
jsBridge: `Optional.map` is like `x?.pipe(f)` if JS had one: it applies `f` only when there's a value. `flatMap` is for when `f` itself returns an optional (like `Int.init`). It's the same `map`/`flatMap` split as for arrays; an optional is a collection of 0 or 1 values.

compass.q: JS has no `Optional.map`, so you write `x == null ? null : f(x)`. Where would `.map` have simplified your JS code?
